api_contract.ConfigValidationError: Subclass of ValueError. All raises include key name and invalid value.
api_contract.load_config: Signature matches spec exactly. Returns dict with all 10 keys. Raises ConfigValidationError/FileNotFoundError as specified.
api_contract.validate_value: Coerces+validates single value; returns coerced value; raises ConfigValidationError for invalid/unknown keys.

validation_rules.range_inclusive: Uses < min or > max — correct inclusive boundary semantics.
validation_rules.enum_case_sensitive: Direct string comparison; no .lower() on allowed values.

type_coercion.int: Excludes bool subclass; int() parse; ConfigValidationError on failure.
type_coercion.float: Excludes bool; float() parse; int→float; ConfigValidationError on failure.
type_coercion.bool: Python bool passthrough; string mapping case-insensitive; int 1/0; ConfigValidationError otherwise.
type_coercion.enum: str() coercion; membership check; ConfigValidationError on mismatch.

priority_cascade.order: Step1 defaults → Step2 config file → Step3 env vars → Step4 CLI args. Correctly implements CLI > env > file > defaults.
priority_cascade.all_keys_present: Initialized with defaults; every key always in output.
priority_cascade.override_semantics: Each layer unconditionally overwrites; higher-priority always wins.

error_handling.ConfigValidationError: Proper ValueError subclass with descriptive messages.
error_handling.FileNotFoundError: open() raises natively for missing config_file.
error_handling.unknown_keys: Silently ignored in config file (not an error).

env_var_mapping.detail: All 10 WEB_* → key mappings verified against spec table.

notes: Float coercion code exists but is unused by current 10-key schema — harmless.
validate_value rejects unknown keys — reasonable beyond-spec behavior.
